enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Remain asleep.

Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Toaster pops. Put bread on plate. Pour juice into glass. Sit on chair. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink juice. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Put down comb. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Take off coat. Put on scrubs. Close locker. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Read patient notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take blood pressure. Record results. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient room. Repeat. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Restock cart. Walk to patient room. Assist patient. Walk to station. Write notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay at cashier. Find table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Stand up. Return tray. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check IV. Change bandage. Administer injection. Talk to patient. Walk to station. Answer phone. Write notes. Walk to lab. Pick up results. Walk to doctor. Discuss results. Walk to patient room. Explain procedure. Assist with procedure. Clean equipment. Walk to station. Update records.

Change out of scrubs. Put on coat. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Step on bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Take off shoes.

Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Cut vegetables. Pick up pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV or using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Check email. Put down computer. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Drink water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Continue reading. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down on bed. Close eyes.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Remain asleep.
